- **Fruits:** Berries and other whole fruits provide polyphenols and fiber, though portion sizes still matter.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESuQEBxCJF1-oo8nxyvCu6ScaPMSXx5M4hyXogowNUP1msjLLVF7Bb8t-bxL8Bj5TdSawNUXov5i52LN4vuPAHnnM6aXdphgNKBX6-EFARrs5hfNLVAEwAmIGhXuOosGDwmL-VpLnFr5t35tMyGP1uS_QIxdiP6u9QigEeB3uebP_yqN4KSlGW1HdYEsHFoGEXV-EjxN_lQTFji4PbwSBjo18NeIg0kfM3429qliPUGOY9-WUdBxU6GCzA3A)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESlQEBxCJF14okhY616JmRqmmI9GBtelmPwzU6F7U1SDq6oCKHyBsRX-xEyZhcZ4bsOvtRAGZiuNQIsfPRf-qYOJPEiACTPC-ivQPkEokEbPu9cRg1fGavVb8Id7bgqDIBYaUoMFfxHe0xaDD2FprZWP-n3tl4OFdbhKPGt3G62I_hYA7mUGTenu1ydEFFyqRRli1GkMebGg)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESlwEBxCJF1-qH3h3kzk9pmTjoYgOrnJnVeg5SCK3rK5bWSNDNx1xuTfYc4SH0Khzo_aw4jiuub9K-a260vjDVbKxsOp0gcdipGZ9NzMzVpZBRXA7Gj0Ake0R6VbreM_uuS16ESSTxOdFbt63X2QZyCa17FZ6tQqojnaZUAZvN7GVdUY-7ukwxt-jnhPJPcdSfkkmo1jL69F9d)
- **Unsweetened coffee and tea:** Plain coffee and green tea are linked to lower liver inflammation and fibrosis risk when consumed without added sugar. ### Foods and Drinks to Limit or Avoid

- **Added sugars and sugary drinks:** Sodas, sweetened teas, juices, and sweets drive fat buildup in the liver.
- **Refined carbs and fried foods:** White bread, white rice, pastries, and deep-fried items worsen insulin resistance and inflammation.
- **Saturated and trans fats:** Limit red meat, processed meats, butter, and full-fat dairy, and avoid trans fats.

items.title: Foods and Drinks to Limit or Avoid
items.text: Added sugars and sugary drinks: Sodas, sweetened teas, juices, and sweets drive fat buildup in the liver. Refined carbs and fried foods: White bread, white rice, pastries, and deep-fried items worsen insulin resistance and inflammation. Saturated and trans fats: Limit red meat, processed meats, butter, and full-fat dairy, and avoid trans fats. Alcohol: Avoiding or strictly limiting alcohol helps protect the liver from further strain and damage.
items.markdown:
- **Added sugars and sugary drinks:** Sodas, sweetened teas, juices, and sweets drive fat buildup in the liver.
- **Refined carbs and fried foods:** White bread, white rice, pastries, and deep-fried items worsen insulin resistance and inflammation.
- **Saturated and trans fats:** Limit red meat, processed meats, butter, and full-fat dairy, and avoid trans fats.
